usedFor: Clappia holds submissions from your custom apps, and “Create Clappia Submission” adds one while “Update Submission Status” moves it along.

bestTemplate.name: “Create Clappia Submission” in Clappia
bestTemplate.why: It fills a chosen Clappia app with form data from the run.

watchOut: “Create Clappia Submission” needs a requester email along with the form data, so check it is filled in.
